💹 TradeSim

A trading simulation: buy goods at low prices in one market, transport them to another, and sell for a profit. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Buy goods at a low price in one market.
  2. Transport goods to another market where prices are higher.
  3. Account for transport costs in your profit calculation.
  4. Watch market prices — they change over time.
  5. Build a network of trade routes for steady profits.
